about_the_game:
🜂 Mitrys — Your journey begins where legend ends

A third-person, story-driven action RPG for a single player, set in a world shaped by memory, choices, and ancient power.

The world you once knew has changed.
Not destroyed — but transformed.
You walk familiar paths, but nothing is quite the same.
What you remember has shifted.
What was hidden is stirring.
And what you thought was true... may never have been.

Mitrys takes you deep into the rich, multilayered universe known from the novels of Paweł Kopijer—but from a completely new perspective.

📖 A narrative adventure for solo players

✔️ A rich, branching story shaped by your actions
✔️ No time pressure — play at your own pace, discover the world your way
✔️ A handcrafted world, refined down to the smallest detail

📖 Untold stories, hidden truths

The world of Mitrys lives in the shadow of the main saga—but breathes with a life of its own.
Dive into stories pulled from the margins of the canon—full of faded truths and characters that history tried to forget.
Every thread is reactive, shaped by your alliances, betrayals, and sacrifices.

Not every hero ends up in songs.
Not every villain chosen to become one.

🧙‍♂️ Complex characters that remember

From exiled nobles to cursed mystics—every character you meet is more than just a quest-giver.
They evolve in response to your choices.
They remember your actions.
They change because of you.

  • Dynamic dialogue systems

  • Relationships based on memory and consequence

  • Allies can become enemies—and vice versa

  • In this world, even silence speaks volumes

🏰 A land reshaped

Traverse a reimagined realm—crumbling castles, forests full of secrets, temples swallowed by time.

🔍 Core Gameplay Features

  • 🎮 Third-person perspective with full camera control

  • 🛡️ Real-time combat: dodge, block, diverse weapons and abilities

  • 📈 Character development: levels, skills, and choices that shape your role

  • 🌍 Exploration-focused design: no quest markers—follow clues, details, and your intuition

  • 🤝 A reactive world and NPCs: your actions shift alliances, character fates, and even reshape the world

  • 🧩 Branching narrative: big and small decisions influence the unfolding story

  • 🏰 Varied environments: haunted woods, ancient ruins, forgotten temples

  • 🎧 Atmospheric music and sound design that elevate story and action

💬 For story-seekers and action fans alike

Whether you’re drawn to exploration, combat, or moral dilemmas

What’s just in one realm may be cruelty in another.

  • 🎯 Single-player

  • 🎮 Action-adventure + narrative RPG

  • ⚖️ For players who value exploration, moral choices, and a world that reacts to them

🔔 Add Mitrys to your wishlist and prepare to step onto the path that was always meant for you.

Your journey begins where legend fades.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is set in a dark fantasy world and contains mature themes intended for adult audiences. Players may encounter scenes involving violence, horror, strong language, and suggestive content. These elements are woven into the narrative to support a deep, emotionally charged story in line with the dark fantasy RPG genre.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: Dualcore (Intel i3 / AMD Athlon etc.)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050/ Readeon RX 560
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/ Windows 11
  • Processor: multicore (Intel i5/Ryzen3)
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 5060/ AMD Radeon 9060 XT
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
